html:
There’s no doubt that NEET and JEE are some of the toughest competitive exams that you will have to write as a student. And you might be wondering if the exam you will have to face will be tougher or easier. Students tend to worry about this and get anxious in their preparation. There’s also the myth that exams get tougher with each passing year. However, this is not the case at all.

Will JEE/NEET be tougher in 2022?
Many, many students assume that JEE (Mains and Advanced) and NEET exams will actually become more and more tough as the years pass. This is actually not always true. Either way, should this matter to NEET and JEE aspirants?

The answer is a big, resounding NO. Ranks are entirely based on relative performance. This is why you should not get scared or anxious of a tough JEE paper. It means that the paper may be tough for all aspirants. Just stay calm, do your best, and try to perform well. Your performance during the exam is all that matters. In general, those who are level-headed and not anxious while writing the exam are the ones who perform well.

Strategy for a Tough JEE Paper
There’s no such thing as a strategy for a “tough” paper. The most important thing is to not panic. Everything in the paper is relative. The cut-offs fluctuate because if the paper is tough for you, it is tough for everyone, and similarly, if you find it easy, it’s likely that all candidates find it easy.

So, what should you do?
Don’t worry about the difficulty of the 2022 exam! Prepare well and focus on having a good understanding of all concepts. Ensure that you are mentally prepared for the exam and be confident when you write it. All the best!
